would write {{service}}:
[Unit]
Description=gh board watch of acme/7

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment="GH_PATH=/usr/bin/gh"
ExecStart="{{binq}}" "watch" "--once" "--project" "acme/7"
would write {{timer}}:
[Unit]
Description=gh board watch every 10min

[Timer]
OnStartupSec=1min
OnUnitActiveSec=10min
Unit=gh-board.watch.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
would run systemctl --user daemon-reload
would run systemctl --user enable --now gh-board.watch.timer
